Had an amazing time at Dave & Buster’s, Infiniti Mall (Andheri West)!

🍗 Chicken Wings and Game Day Grub Platter (Non-Veg) – juicy, flavorful, and great for sharing.

Service was quick, staff were friendly, and the overall vibe was fun and energetic.

Highly recommend for anyone looking to combine great food, drinks, and games under one roof. 🎮🍔🍹

featured_reviews.name: Divya Duggal
featured_reviews.review_text:
I have celebrated my daughter's 10th birthday at time zone phoneix market city kurla.It was a lovely place for kids to play.  The decoration was beautiful.  It was perfectly organized, and we had a wonderful time. I would like to appreciate kavita and her team they handled kids very nicely. I would like to thank kavita and pradnya both for all co-ordination and co-operation. Kavita was always with us to guide kids.
Just a draw back I did not like the food quantity which was not upto the mark. They told each  platter dish will be served to 10 people. But hardly 4 people ate from that quantity. I requested pradnya to arrange more quantity. She took a charge and they served little more. The food served to the kids was in disposable black boxes honestly it was not looking good and I found quantity also very less. As they charge 450 rs per kid  for food and they served in a plastic boxes which was looking very cheap. Just a suggestion it should be served in a plate..  thank you..

Thank you so much, Divya! 🎉 We're delighted to have been a part of your daughter's special day and that you enjoyed the beautiful decorations and our wonderful team, especially Kavita and Pradnya! featured_reviews.name: Disha Shetty
featured_reviews.review_text:
I came bowling here and to eat, the server kept our pizza close to a baby on a table that wasn’t cleared and didn’t care that a baby’s shoe was falling on the pizza! The server saw it and didn’t say anything till I called it out and he straight up said it is not my mistake, as if we were supposed to eat a pizza that had a shoe on it, and asked us what do you expect me to do.

We had to ask him to get a new pizza, which they took forever to even agree to and finally got our pizza almost after 45-50 mins and our game was done and we just waited at a table for the pizza to come.

There is no customer service whatsoever and the servers ruined our date night.

The pizza is good, but the staff was awful.

My server was Gopal, highly recommend not having him serve your table
